description: WEDM tips derived from MIT OCW course integration

tips.title: Discharge energy determines crater size
tips.content: Per MIT 2.008: E = V*I*t_on determines crater depth. For Ra<0.5um, limit energy per pulse to <0.1mJ.

tips.title: Dielectric breakdown threshold
tips.content: Dielectric breakdown requires ~20-100 V/um. Gap voltage must exceed this for spark initiation.

tips.title: Thermal diffusion length limits MRR
tips.content: L_thermal = sqrt(alpha * t_on). Longer on-time increases removal but also HAZ depth.
tips.citation: MIT 2.008: Thermal Physics of Spark Erosion

tips.title: Kunieda model assumptions
tips.content: Kunieda MRR assumes single-spark-at-a-time. Multi-spark regime increases MRR 2-5x but degrades surface.

tips.title: Wire tension affects accuracy
tips.content: Wire deflection ~F*L/(T+k*v). Higher tension = better accuracy but higher break risk.

tips.title: Flushing pressure vs cutting speed
tips.content: MRR plateaus above ~10 bar flushing. Over-flushing causes wire vibration.

tips.title: Adaptive control reduces wire breaks
tips.content: PID with Kp=0.8, Ki=0.15, Kd=0.05 on gap voltage reduces breaks 40% vs open-loop.

tips.title: Process capability Cpk targets
tips.content: WEDM Cpk >= 1.33 for automotive, >= 1.67 for aerospace. Measure on 30+ consecutive parts.

tips.title: Kalman filter for wire position
tips.content: EKF with process noise 0.001mm^2, measurement noise 0.01mm^2 tracks wire to +/- 5um.

tips.title: Nelson SPC rules for wire break prediction
tips.content: 7 consecutive points trending upward in gap voltage = wire break imminent within 30s.

tips.title: Feedforward + feedback architecture
tips.content: Feedforward on nominal parameters + feedback on gap voltage = 20% better Ra consistency.

tips.title: Ziegler-Nichols tuning for servo
tips.content: For WEDM servo: Kp_crit = 0.6 via relay test, set Kp=0.5*Kp_crit for stability margin.

tips.title: Johnson's algorithm for 2-machine scheduling
tips.content: For WEDM + inspection flow: sort jobs by min(proc_edm, proc_inspect). Reduces makespan 15-25%.

tips.title: Little's Law for WIP control
tips.content: WIP = throughput * cycle_time. Target WIP = 1-2 jobs per WEDM to minimize flow time.

tips.title: Changeover time minimization
tips.content: Group jobs by material then wire size then E-code. Reduces changeovers by 60-80%.

tips.title: Critical ratio for priority scheduling
tips.content: CR = days_until_due / days_remaining_work. CR<1 = late, schedule first. CR>1.5 = slack.

tips.title: Economic batch size for WEDM
tips.content: EOQ = sqrt(2*D*S/h). For WEDM: D=demand, S=setup+programming cost, h=carrying cost.

tips.title: SVD for program similarity
tips.content: SVD of program feature matrix: top-k singular vectors capture 90%+ variance for k=20-30.

tips.title: PCA for parameter reduction
tips.content: PCA on 28 WEDM parameters reduces to 5-7 principal components explaining 85%+ variance.

tips.title: Least squares for calibration
tips.content: Linear least squares: theta = (X^T X)^-1 X^T y. Add ridge term lambda*I for stability.

tips.title: Eigenvalue stability check
tips.content: Servo system matrix eigenvalues must have Re(lambda) < 0 for stability. Check after parameter changes.

tips.title: Gaussian Process calibration for uncertainty
tips.content: GP posterior variance provides calibrated uncertainty. Report mean +/- 2*sigma for 95% CI.
tips.citation: MIT 6.S191 Lecture: Uncertainty in Deep Learning

tips.title: Dropout as Bayesian approximation
tips.content: Keep dropout active at inference, run 50 samples, use variance as uncertainty estimate.

tips.title: Transfer learning for new materials
tips.content: Freeze first 3 layers, fine-tune last 2 with 20+ samples for new material. 10x less data needed.

tips.title: Out-of-distribution detection
tips.content: Use Mahalanobis distance in penultimate layer. d > 3 sigma = OOD, flag prediction.

tips.title: Active learning for sparse data
tips.content: Query points with highest predictive uncertainty. Reduces required labels 3-5x vs random.
